2. Vertical Shift: Adding +1 to the outside of the function results in a vertical translation of the graph 1 unit upwards.

Therefore, the graph of y = f(x - 2) + 1 should be positioned to the right and above the graph of y = f(x).

A. The graph of y = f(x - 2) + 1 is shifted to the left and downwards relative to y = f(x). This is incorrect.
B. The graph of y = f(x - 2) + 1 is shifted to the right and downwards relative to y = f(x). This is incorrect.
C. The graph of y = f(x - 2) + 1 is shifted to the right and upwards relative to y = f(x). This matches our analysis.
D. The graph of y = f(x - 2) + 1 is shifted to the left and upwards relative to y = f(x). This is incorrect.

Thus, the correct option is C.
